run_render_gaussian_turntables: run the script to render turn-table MP4 videos of Gaussian Splat reconstructions from the uCO3D dataset
render_gaussians_360_video: render a 360-degree turn-table video of Gaussian Splat splats using a circular camera path and OpenCV rasterizer
truncate_gaussians_outside_sphere: truncate Gaussian Splat points outside a spherical boundary centered on the foreground centroid
generate_circular_camera_path: generate a circular camera path with configurable radius, height, focal length, and frame count for turn-table rendering
build_gaussian_splat_dataset: build a uCO3D dataset loader configured to load only Gaussian Splat reconstructions with alignment applied
